harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified: Fixed 2026-11-24, before any result (Rule 22, #758). Pilot classes-18, retained evidence, normal world. The #731 null was one pin (6cd5c8bf), one block, pre-walk-away; this read re-asks it at the current head. Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's value in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; identical plays per arm (the #731 experience says roughly a fifth of plays change). Progress endpoint CL5 reached by 100,000 turns - known attainment out of all starts, deaths, unfinished and alive at the cutoff with CL5 reported separately; DL3/DL5 and level arrival as diagnostics. Report: deaths and causes; paired CL5 gained and lost over pairs known in both arms (exact McNemar); the fire inventory - the #1066 marker counts per game, the triggering monsters (race, CL, DL of the Borg), and for every pair where a death differs the first diverging key with what each arm did - reconstructed from the retained notes; named cases (/death-report) for those pairs. Descriptive (RULES 14). A second step only after this read, on the owner's word.
